items.comment: A clean two-bar sequence over A minor and G; the eighth-note figures are stepwise and sit comfortably at this tempo.
Singable, plain Foster-style line with a clear half-note cadence on C and a pickup into the next phrase.
A simple stepwise carol line; the only non-chord tones are passing notes on weak beats.

objections.problem: The run starts on F5 over the C4 bass, so the downbeat of bar 2 is a dissonant fourth; acceptable as an appoggiatura.

items.comment: Tidy classical figure; the G7 to C motion in bars 4-5 is handled well and the rhythm is easy.

objections.problem: The eighth rest followed by an off-beat eighth G4 in bar 2 is the one syncopated spot a beginner must count carefully.

items.comment: Arpeggio opening and stepwise descent read like a real tune; the hands alternate rather than overlap, so nothing clashes.

objections.problem: D5 on beat 4 of bar 12 sits a seventh above the left hand's E3; mild, but it rubs.
Four running eighths in the left hand in bar 11 make this the busiest spot for a beginner.

items.comment: The melody is shapely and stepwise; the left hand is more active than the tune needs.
